# Tax Documentation: Generate Tax Documentation Document

Area overview and notes: [tax-documentation.md](../tax-documentation.md)

`POST /tax-documentation-data/document` · account-owner-scoped token

Generates a PDF for an Account Owner's tax document. This endpoint requires you to specify which tax document type to generate.

**Request body** (required, JSON)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `document_type` | string | Yes | The type of tax documentation PDF to generate. One of: `W-9`, `W-8BEN`, `W-8BEN-E`, `W-8IMY`, `SELF_CERTIFICATION`. |

Example request body:

```json
{"document_type":"SELF_CERTIFICATION"}
```

**Response 200**: Document submitted

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string (uuid) | Yes | The Taxbit UUID for the Tax Documentation document. |
| `type` | string | Yes | The type of tax documentation PDF to generate. One of: `W-9`, `W-8BEN`, `W-8BEN-E`, `W-8IMY`, `SELF_CERTIFICATION`. |
| `status` | string | Yes | Tax documentation PDF generation status. One of: `PROCESSING`, `FINISHED`, `ERROR`. |
| `url` | string | No | URL to download the Tax Documentation PDF. |
| `created_date` | string | Yes | The date and time the Tax Documentation document was created. |
| `signature_timestamp` | string | No | The date and time the Tax Documentation PDF was generated. |

**Errors:** 400 Invalid Data · 401 Forbidden · 403 Wrong Account Owner · 404 Tax Documentation Document Not Found · 429 Too Many Requests
